thread:
mira chen: Quick ask — we need granular pricing + eviction inputs from HW partners for the cost model. Can partners drop a CSV or quick bullets by EOD Thu?

dan peterson: +1. specifically: per-region SKU availability timelines, reserved-month minimums, any early termination fees, and marketplace listing/transaction fees.

olivia r.: Also need the empirical spot preemption probability (monthly) or a percentile eviction curve if they have it. recent volatility matters for our fallback routing.

samir khan: vendor question: do we want daily or monthly eviction rates? monthly is fine for cost sims, but we'll want daily for SLO planning.

mira chen: start with monthly. if they can provide a distribution (p10/p50/p90) even better.

kevin t.: one more: some partners bill partial-day GPU usage; others round up to hour/day. we need their rounding rule + any minimum-billing window.

olivia r.: can we send a template? I'll paste a tiny CSV sample they can fill:
```
region,gpu_family,sku,reserved_price_usd_per_month,spot_price_usd_per_hour,spot_eviction_rate_pct_month,avg_preemptions_per_month,min_commit_months,early_term_fee_pct,marketplace_listing_pct,egress_usd_per_gb,partial_day_billing_rule
us-west-2,a100-80gb,sku-a100x,12000,3.5,12,1.8,12,10,2.5,0.09,round-up-hour
eu-central-1,rtx6000,sku-rtx6,9000,2.8,8,1.1,6,0,3.0,0.12,pro-rated-day
```

mira chen: Perfect. Also can partners provide any known upcoming SKU deprecations or generation ramps (e.g., <6mo) — this affects model-availability routing.

supply-bot: Reminder: vendor-contracts channel has linked legal redlines. If uploading pricing spreadsheets, please anonymize customer-specific clauses. :lock: 

dan peterson: For cost modelling we also want breakpoints for volume discounts (e.g., >500 GPU-months => 5% off). If they have tiered pricing, include the thresholds and effective discount.

samir khan: FYI asking finance: do we need to bake in marketplace take-rates separately from listing_pct? finance might want them split into listing, transaction, and settlement fees.

mira chen: Good call. Add column names: marketplace_listing_pct, marketplace_txn_pct, settlement_fee_usd.

olivia r.: I'll update the CSV template and ping vendor contacts. Who's owning vendor outreach? @dan peterson?

dan peterson: I can reach out to three vendors (their cloud partners + two hardware ISVs). I'll ask for: 1) CSV filled, 2) short text answers for edge cases (early-termination policy, partial-day billing examples), 3) any historical eviction logs (aggregated).

kevin t.: For historical eviction logs, ask for a 12-month monthly series (month, evictions, requests) — aggregated is fine, no customer IDs. That helps our sim to generate survival curves.

mira chen: Deadline: please push responses into this thread and attach CSVs by Thu 6pm PT. If any vendor needs more time, flag here so we can adjust the modeling window.

olivia r.: pinging vendor emails now. i'll cc legal for redline check before we accept any spreadsheet with contract clauses.

samir khan: Quick modelling note: if a partner provides only spot/ondemand (no reserved), we'll assume equivalent reserved price = spot*24*30*(1 - 0.25) as a conservative proxy — this is our fallback, call it "proxy-reserved".

mira chen: Noted. We'll surface proxy-reserved clearly in the cost report.

dan peterson: one non-obvious ask for vendors: do they support multi-tenancy at the hypervisor level or do they isolate per-tenant GPUs? billing and latency tail behave differently. ask them to state isolation mode.

olivia r.: Added to CSV as isolation_model (shared/hw-passthrough/dedicated).

mira chen: Thanks team. If anyone gets a vendor quirk (e.g., per-minute billing for preempted workloads, or termination penalties under marketplace credits), drop a short note in-thread. Those edge cases drive our fallback policies.

kevin t.: will do. cheers :raised_hands:

supply-bot: Attached: vendor-contact-list.csv (internal).

mira chen: closing loop — once we have CSVs in, eng-cost and product will run a candidate-sensitivity sweep and share top-3 cost levers.

dan peterson: thanks all — I'll post confirmations as replies come in.
